items.t: Front crossmember rusts and control arm can break loose
items.job: Replace front suspension crossmember and control arm bushings
items.note: Owners report $400 to over $1,000 out of pocket. GM's special coverage ran 10 years/150,000 miles, so most trucks are now outside it.

items.t: Front axle clunks or 4WD pops out of gear
items.job: Replace front differential case, actuator and side bearings
items.note: One owner paid about $1,380 total.

items.t: Automatic transmission slips or downshifts on its own
items.job: Transmission diagnosis per GM bulletin, fluid service
items.note: If internal damage is found, a rebuild costs much more.

items.t: Engine overheats
items.job: Diagnose overheating and repair cooling system or head gasket
items.note: Owners report about $1,600 on average; a simple hose or thermostat costs far less.

items.t: Engine runs rough or dies when hot
items.note: Diagnosis only (RepairPal: $122–179). The repair cost depends on what is found.

items.t: Engine shakes when coming to a stop
items.note: Covers worn mounts only; misfires or a dirty throttle body are separate fixes. Based on RepairPal: $201–$288 total; YourMechanic averages $558. No parts-plus-labor source found.

items.t: Ticking noise from the engine
items.job: Diagnose engine noise per GM bulletin
items.note: Diagnosis only (RepairPal: $122–179). The repair cost depends on what is found.

items.t: Slow start or no-start in very cold weather
items.note: Diagnosis only (RepairPal: $122–179). The repair cost depends on what is found.

items.t: 2.5L V6 hard to start or won't start at times
items.note: Diagnosis only (RepairPal: $122–179). The repair cost depends on what is found.

items.t: Ignition key sticks or binds
items.note: Based on RepairPal: $225–$282 for 1999–2000 and $372–$429 for 2001; no parts-plus-labor source found.

items.t: Serpentine belt squeals or frays
items.note: Based on estimators; no parts-plus-labor source found. RepairPal: $148–$165; YourMechanic: about $258–$289. A worn tensioner or pulley adds cost.

items.t: Driveline vibration at 35–60 mph
items.note: Diagnosis only (about $122–179 at RepairPal rates). Balancing or driveshaft parts are extra.

items.t: Brake pedal pulsates from rotor corrosion
items.job: Clean hub faces and replace front brake rotors
items.note: Based on YourMechanic: about $404 average for rotor replacement ($693–$708 quoted for 1999–2002 fronts with pads); no parts-plus-labor source found.

items.t: Front end creaks or pops over bumps and in turns
items.job: Replace worn control arm bushings or ball joints
items.note: RepairPal estimates $266–336 for control arm bushings and $136–287 for a ball joint.

items.t: Water gets into main fuse box and corrodes it
items.note: Diagnosis only (about $122–179 at RepairPal rates). A new junction box costs extra.

items.t: Front windows bind or tip forward
items.note: Adjusting the glass channel per GM bulletin may be enough. Based on estimators: YourMechanic about $391–$399 for 1999–2002 fronts; RepairPal $419–$493 for a 2004.

items.t: Door handles break
items.note: Owners report about $600 on average.

items.t: Instrument cluster or lights flicker
items.note: Diagnosis only (RepairPal: $122–179). The repair cost depends on what is found.

items.t: Rattle in neutral with clutch released
items.note: RepairPal estimates $1,439–1,743 for a clutch replacement.

items.t: Heater blows from the wrong vents or quits
items.note: This is the cost when the heater core has failed; an air-direction fault per the GM bulletin costs less. Based on RepairPal: $1,091–$1,526 for 1999–2002 (dash must come out); no parts-plus-labor source found.

items.t: Fuel gauge stuck after filling up
items.job: Fuel gauge diagnosis per GM bulletin
items.note: Diagnosis only (about $122–179 at RepairPal rates).

items.t: Check engine light from loose or worn gas cap
items.note: Try tightening or replacing the cap before paying for diagnosis.

items.t: Steering shaft coupling may crack (safety campaign)
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done.

items.t: Windshield may not be held in properly (safety campaign)
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done.
